name: Little Man
source: A man with a poor childhood tries his best to overcome and forget, but nightmares pursue them, and he feels he needs to do something, by finding an artifact that will give him a chance to fix his life and bring him a lot of fun.
translation: 一個童年不幸的男人一直竭力擺脫並忘掉過去，可惡夢始終糾纏著他。他覺得自己必須有所行動，於是動身尋找一件神秘遺物。只要得到它，他就有機會讓人生回到正軌，還能給自己找不少樂子。
